payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedy column removal: scan columns left to right, if a column breaks lexicographic order among row prefixes, remove it and recheck the same index.
payload.rationale: The algorithm iterates columns, checks prefix order, and when a violation occurs, it deletes that column and decrements the index to recheck. This backtracking of the index mimics a backtracking step, though it's a deterministic greedy algorithm, not exploring multiple possibilities. It is not a complete search or permutation enumeration.
